text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, October 15 - Bombay - Delays expected for vessels due, containers 2-3 days, bulkers 5-6 days, general cargo 4-5 days. 6 Vessels loading at berth, 21 discharging at berth, 8 discharging at anchorage. 6 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 13 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 bunkering. 9 Vessels under repair, 2 awaiting orders. Calcutta - Fourteen vessels due of which 1 coal, 10 product tankers, 3 containers. 6 Vessels loading at berth, 9 discharging at berth, 2 bunkering. Cochin - Vessels due, 2 liners, 1 mop/dap/urea, 1 rock phosphate/sulphur, 1 steel/grain/coal/sugar, 1 scrap, 1 crude, 2 petroleum products. Delays expected, up to 1 day for liners, fertiliser, general cargo, 1-2 days for crude.

Two tankers waiting at anchorage of which 1 crude, 1 phosphoric acid. 2 Vessels under repair/drydock. Murmugao - One petcoke due, up to 1 days delay expected, 7 ores due, 4-5 days delay expected. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 3 loading at anchorage, 1 discharging at berth, 5 waiting anchorage to load. 5 Vessels under repair/drydock, 1 awaiting orders. Kandla - Delays expected for vessels due, rice 4-5 days, teus 2-3 days, pipes 4-5 days, sulphur 4-5 days, granite blocks 6-7 days, alumina products 5-6 days. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 19 Tankers waiting.

Mangalore - Delays expected for vessels due, granite blocks loading up to 1 day, iron ore concentrate/pelts 2-3 days. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth. Madras - Thirty-nine vessels due of which 6 coal/coke, 5 edible oil, 11 containers, 8 general cargo, 1 sugar, 2 granite blocks, 1 scrap, 1 molasses, 1 sulphur, 1 urea, 1 scrap, 1 mop, 1 iron ore, 1 pulses. Delays expected, coal/coke 3-4 days, fertiliser 2-3 days, scrap 4-5 days, others 2-3 days, no delays for containers and iron ore. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 11 discharging at berth, 11 waiting at anchage to discharge, 2 under repair. Jawaharlal Nehru - Four vessels (fertiliser/raw materials), 15-20 days delay expected, 3 tankers due, 2-3 days delay expected. 2 Vessels discharging at berth (fertiliser and raw material).

Paradip - Vessels due, 4 coal, 1 chrome, 1 iron ore, 1 food, 2 chemicals. Delays expected, 2 days for iron ore. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Tuticorin - Six vessels due, 1 days delay expected. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 awaiting orders. Visakhapatnam - Vessels due, 3 export iron ore, 1 each export pig iron, export steel cargo, export thermal coal, export granite blocks, export alumina, export molasses, palm oil, general cargo, caustic soda. Import aid cargo, 2 import coal, 3 import rock phosphate, 2 import phosphoric acid, 3 import iron ore. Delays expected, 1-2 days for iron ore, pig iron, steel cargo, phosphoric acid, general cargo, caustic soda, up to 1 day for thermal coal, alumina, molasses, palm oil, aid cargo, 2-3 days for granite blocks, 7-8 days for coal and phosphate, 5-6 days for import iron ore. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 8 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load at inner harbour berth, 5 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth. 1 Vessel under repair.

MAURITIUS, October 15 - Port Louis - Two container vessels alongside for discharging and loading, 3 general cargo alongside for discharging. No idle vessels in port, 1 in drydock. Fishing port still very busy. Approx. 30 other vessels in port of which 10 alongside. 20 Buoys berthed, port labour working normally.
PHILIPPINES, October 15 - Manila - South harbour - 7 Vessels discharging at berth, 3 discharging at anchorage, 7 others (withholding orders, etc.). No berthing delays.

SINGAPORE, October 15 - Singapore - Tanjong pagar container terminal - 12 Container vessels berthed, min. berthing delays. Keppel terminal - 13 Container/general cargo vessels berthed, min. berthing delays. Pasir panjang terminal - 11 Container/general cargo vessels berthed, min. berthing delays. Sembawang terminal - 2 General cargo vessels berthed, min. berthing delays. Jurongort - 3 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessels berthed, min. berthing delays. Oil terminal/sbm buoys - 19 Tankers berthed, min. berthing delays.

SOUTH KOREA - October 15 - Inchon - Eighty-one vessels in port (48 berthed, 33 anchored) of which 10 general cargo, 9 logs, 4 each containers, plywood, 3 each cars, wheat, 2 each steel, soybean meal, scrap, 1 each copper, tapioca, cement, rape blending pellets, steel plates, salt, corn, rye, silica sand. Anchored, 5 containers, 4 each general cargo, soybean, 3 each wheat blending pellets, cars, logs, 2 each copra, scrap, 1 each corn, soybean meal, pig iron, steel bars, ingots, coils, rape blending pellets. Approx. 2-3 days delay expected. Busan - One hundred and sixty-three vessels in port (49 berthed, 114 anchored including 56 laid up) of which 34 general cargo, 7 containers, 4 each scrap, coal. 58 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 2-3 days delay expected.

Pohang - 12 vessels Berthed of which discharging, 1 each coal, iron ore, wire rods, steel billets, structure, slabs. 6 Vessels loading steel, no berthing delays expected. Ulsan - 26 Vessels in port (21 berthed, 5 anchored) of which discharging, 3 feed meal, 1 each mono ethyl glycol, coal, cement, styrene monomer, urea, woodchips, zinc concentrate, barytes, silica sand, normal butanol, wheat, kerosene, crude oil. Loading, 3 general cargo, 1 each steel pipes, toluene. 5 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 3 days delay expected, but for feed meal approx. 10-15 days delay expected. Masan - Three vessels discharging of which 1 steel scrap, 1 steel plates, 1 pig iron, no berthing delays expected.

SRI LANKA, October 15 - Colombo - Nine vessels due, 3-4 days delay expected. 14 Vessels loading at berth of which 5 essential services, 9 containers. 21 Vessels discharging at berth of which 2 bagged sugar, 1 palm oil, 1 steel cargo, 1 lpg, 2 general cargo, 2 bagged fertiliser, 2 bagged cement, 1 ro/ro, 9 containers. 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load of which 1 general cargo, 1 essential services. 15 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge of which 8 containers (discharging/loading), 1 each bagged sugar, bagged fertiliser, bagged cement, steel, bulk cement, 2 rice. 6 Vessels under repair/drydock, 2 awaiting orders. Galle - Two vessels discharging at berth. Trincomalee - One vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth.

TAIWAN, October 12 - Keelung - Two vessels anchored. Berthing delays, coal 3 days, steel/iron ore 2 days, no delays for grain. Kaohsiung - Three vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 1 day, iron/coal 3 days (csc berth), coal/scrap 1 day (public berth), steel 1 day. Taichung - Five vessels anchored. Berthing delays, iron ore, coal, steel and others 1 day, no delays for grain, scrap. October 14 - Kaohsiung - Vessels in port, 13 containers, 8 tankers, 2 grain, other bulkers, 35 generals, 12 buoys. 1 Grain vessel waiting at outer anchorage with berthing delay of 4 days. Keelung - Vessels in port, 11 containers, 1 tanker, 6 other bulkers, 2 general cargo. 4 Container vessels waiting at outer anchorage with 16 hours berthing delay.

THAILAND, October 15 - bangkok - Ninety-one vessels in port of which 4 containers, 1 tanker, 86 other bulkers and general cargo vessels. 7 Vessels waiting at outer anchorage, no berthing delays expected.
